Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Replay Duel provisioning and signaling service

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

This separate native service hosts fixed two-player enrollment rooms and their authenticated WebRTC mesh signaling, plus pair keys for native encrypted ENet. Gameplay stays on the participants. Private SQLite bundles contain invitation/enrollment secrets and current incarnations; they are never sent as gameplay checkpoints.

Build/import this Godot project with the repository's usual native pipeline:

Shell
nix develop
bash build/build_scripts.sh examples/replay_duel_service
export ODIN_SCRIPTS_DLL="$PWD/examples/replay_duel_service/bin/libodinscripts.dylib"
"$GODOT" --headless --path examples/replay_duel_service --editor --quit-after 120
python3 tests/replay_comparison/wait_builds.py examples/replay_duel_service /tmp/duel-service-builds.json
bash build/build_scripts.sh examples/replay_duel_service
DUEL_SERVICE_LOCAL=1 DUEL_SERVICE_CREATE=1 \
DUEL_SERVICE_DB=/absolute/private/directory/duel.sqlite3 \
"$GODOT" --headless --path examples/replay_duel_service

Use .so instead of .dylib on Linux. The database parent directory must already exist. On subsequent starts omit DUEL_SERVICE_CREATE; existing room keys and player counts are restored. Missing/corrupt files fail instead of resetting rooms.

Default port is 9081. In browser Duel's lobby, enter ws://127.0.0.1:9081, enable Local development service, and create a match. Use Invite player to share its invitation with a different browser profile/device, which uses Join match. Same-origin tabs in one profile share the persisted enrollment; they are not independent players. The browser game export includes web_archive.js.

Outside explicit loopback development, provide DUEL_SERVICE_CERT and DUEL_SERVICE_KEY for TLS. DUEL_SERVICE_BIND defaults to 127.0.0.1; DUEL_SERVICE_LOCAL=1 refuses a non-loopback bind. Clients require a trusted WSS certificate. DUEL_SERVICE_PORT changes the listen port, and the optional DUEL_SERVICE_STOP_FILE provides a graceful local shutdown marker.

The implementation bounds rooms at 32 and connections at 128. It does not provide human accounts, service discovery, TURN credential issuance, public room listings or automatic room retirement. This local example does not establish public reachability. Configure ICE/TURN independently where required.

Run tests/replay_p2p_party/run.sh for browser enrollment/gameplay/rejoin and tests/replay_p2p_native/run.sh for native TLS provisioning, encrypted ENet and returned-creator endpoint replacement. No original Kit project is modified.
